title: "ssoosshd ldap"
description: "Directory tools."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in server/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Tools for the optional LDAP directory enrichment, working against the loaded configuration file. probe is read-only and opens no database; sync runs the directory sync now against the server's database.

## Synopsis

```
ssoosshd ldap [command] [flags]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoosshd`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoosshd config file |

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ssoosshd ldap probe`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/ldap-probe/) | Look up one entry and report what the configuration would make of it. |
| [`ssoosshd ldap sync`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/ldap-sync/) | Run the directory sync now, as the admin console's Sync now does. |
